use_case: TaraHome blog cover for a homeowner guide to setting up mesh Wi-Fi for smart-home devices
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: TaraHome blog cover, landscape 3:2
Primary request: Create a clean, photorealistic editorial image about correctly placing mesh Wi-Fi for a reliable smart home.
Scene/backdrop: A warm, lived-in residential interior with a connected living room, open hallway, and kitchen visible in one continuous real space. Pale warm plaster walls, oak shelves and console, linen upholstery, and one restrained dark forest-green ceramic vase or textile accent. The layout itself should make distance and room-to-room coverage understandable without any diagram.
Subject: A homeowner is calmly placing one compact, realistic, unbranded white mesh Wi-Fi point on an open oak console at about waist height in the central hallway, not on the floor and not hidden in a cabinet. A second matching mesh point is naturally visible on an open shelf in the adjoining living room, with believable power cables routed safely to ordinary wall outlets. Keep the person secondary, showing a natural torso, arms, and hands rather than a posed portrait. Add only subtle, ordinary smart-home context in the rooms—a lit table lamp and a normal wall switch—without making any device look like a named commercial model.
Style/medium: premium natural editorial residential photography, believable modern home, practical and calm, not futuristic and not a product advertisement
Composition/framing: wide three-quarter interior view with the homeowner and nearer mesh point in the central safe area and the second point still readable through the room opening; generous breathing room for clean centered 16:9 and 16:10 crops; one continuous scene, no split image, no collage
Lighting/mood: soft natural late-afternoon window light with gentle warm household lighting, reassuring and useful, realistic color, restrained contrast, subtle depth of field
Materials/textures: real oak grain, matte white device shells, woven linen, glazed ceramic, ordinary plaster, believable power cables and outlets
Constraints: realistic hand anatomy, realistic device scale, correct perspective, safe cable placement, no brand marks, no product logos, no readable labels, no text, no letters, no headline, no title, no watermark
Avoid: overhead floor plan, blueprint, cutaway house, chart, graph, arrows, Wi-Fi symbols, signal waves, decorative routing lines, network paths, glowing data trails, translucent panels, inset frames, floating UI cards, progress bars, dashboard, screen interface, fake app, sci-fi glow, generic AI infographic, impossible cables, duplicated devices, excessive clutter, staged stock-photo smile
